question: Which of the following is a well-known variety of coffee initially brought to India from Yemen?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Arabica.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Coffee Arabica** or simply, the Arabian coffee, is a species of flowering plant of the coffee and **madder family Rubiaceae.**
 
• It is considered as the first species of coffee that was cultivated and currently represents about 60% of the global production of coffee.
 
• This species of coffee originated in Ethiopia and was first cultivated in Yemen and then brought to India by Arab scholars.
 
• The plants of this **species of coffee are 9-12 m.**
 
• Arabica Coffee takes around 7 y
